title: An Act to Establish a First-time Home-buyer Program Administered by the Finance Authority of Maine

summary.text: This bill establishes the First-time Home-buyer Program to be administered by the Finance Authority of Maine. The First-time Home-buyer Program is established for the purpose of assisting first-time home buyers across all 16 counties of the State by providing access to affordable mortgage loans with low interest rates and low down payment requirements.
